shadowed-and-immutable-error
rows.source:
fn local(){let push=(v,xs)=>[v+10]
 var xs=[]
 xs=push(1,xs)
 return xs}
assert(local()==[11])
let immutable=[1]
let bad=attempt(()=>{immutable=push(2,immutable)})
assert(!bad.ok)
assert(immutable==[1])
print(bad.error["class"])

var xs=[1]
let cell={alias:nil}
fn next(){cell.alias=xs
 xs[0]=9
 return 2}
xs=push(next(),xs)
assert(cell.alias==[9])
assert(xs==[9,2])
print(jsonStringify([cell.alias,xs]))
